market_name: Will J.D. Vance win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the Vance market move coincided with a concrete news catalyst (e.g., Trump succession news, health event, endorsement) that could actually reprice risk.
time_plan.1h: Compare SPY intraday path to macro drivers (rates, oil, tech leadership) to confirm the political market is not the mover.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if a real political shock is developing that could alter 2026 midterm or policy expectations.
time_plan.6h: Look for follow-through in political-sensitive sectors (defense, energy, healthcare) rather than broad index.
time_plan.12h: Close research window; record that the nomination market had no measurable equity impact absent a concrete catalyst.

predictions.reasoning: A shift in the implied probability of J.D. Vance winning the 2028 Republican nomination is an ultra-long-dated political signal (roughly three years out) with no clear, immediate policy or earnings channel to broad equities. Even a sharp intraday move in this market carries negligible information relevant to S&P 500 cash flows over the next 12 hours. Any correlation would be spurious noise, so the honest mapping is essentially no directional edge.

evidence_used: Market resolves to a 2028 Republican nomination outcome, ~3 years in the future
No category or macro catalyst attached to the question
Resolution depends on party sources, not tradable economic data
uncertainty_notes: A move in Vance odds could reflect an underlying Trump succession/health event that WOULD move markets — but that catalyst, not the nomination probability, would be the real driver
Political prediction markets are thin and prone to idiosyncratic liquidity swings unrelated to fundamentals
Three-year time horizon makes any 12h asset mapping speculative

llm_justification.summary: This market concerns the 2028 Republican presidential nomination — an ultra-long-dated political outcome with no clean, immediate transmission channel to liquid public markets over a 12-hour window. A sharp move in Vance's implied probability would most plausibly be noise or reflect an underlying catalyst (e.g., Trump succession news) that itself would be the actual market driver. We therefore assign an unclear direction and low confidence, well below the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: No coincident, market-moving catalyst is embedded in the Vance odds move
Broad equities are the least-weak proxy but still only weakly exposed
The 12h window is far too short for 2028 political shifts to reprice fundamentals
failure_modes: The Vance move is actually driven by a Trump health/succession shock, in which case defense, energy, and volatility (VIX) — not SPY — would be the correct proxies and could move materially
Prediction market move is pure thin-liquidity noise with zero asset relevance
Any observed SPY co-movement is coincidental and reverses, generating a false signal
Choosing broad equities as proxy understates sector-specific policy exposure (e.g., energy, immigration-sensitive names)
